en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large statue of a robed clergyman (Mgr. Hamer) on a tall stone pedestal in a landscaped park or square. The base is decorated with numerous wreaths and flowers, and two men in dark clothing and hats stand at the left. Trees and a building appear in the background. At the bottom margin in red print is the caption indicating the city and the statue.
